review_method: Independent single-reader visual enumeration of every named caste/category and women cell across complete pinned tables1-6. Counts formed from explicit name lists; existing extraction inspected only after visual counting. No printed counts edited.
finding: The visible named lists themselves contain 68 SC, 4 ST, 4 BC and 39 women mentions. Current extraction has all 115 positive cells with the same categories. The residual printed-total discrepancies are source-internal for this six-page document, not missing OCR rows. This does not establish completeness of the official district-wide reservation universe.
caution: Blank/dash cells are not converted to non-reservation or winner gender. Name-spelling review items are proposed visual readings, with single-reader uncertainty.
